Warning, this is going to be a rant. Feel free to ignore. Its probably going to be snarky and that can be super annoying.

My dad has a huge stigma against 2D games. This man who got me into video games, who played DOS (Neverhood, DOOM, Dragonsphere, Gauntlet, Civ, etc) and NES (Zelda, Mario, you know the stuff) with me back in the day now refuses to look at any games that are not in 3D (not just any 3D, no 2.5D style work, no 2D in 3D space, and it needs to look open world with a moveable camera).

It's so bad he thinks of these 3D games superior in every way regardless of the actual content/design/theme of the game. This same man who has been incredibly supportive of my artwork (comics, illustrations, animations) which majority of times are bloody 2D.

To make this extra stupid, we both share a problem of motion sickness. Neither of us can play many those kinds of 3D games for very long. At best I can play a Katamari non-drugged for 20 minutes. He's even worse, he can't even watch Katamari for 3 minutes without feeling sick.

Tradition has stated that every month or so my father will complain about "the lack of good RPG/space/adventure/etc games" in the past whatever years. Since the only computer games he freaking plays is WOW with more WOW (with a side of Diablo), it doesn't take much to give him examples to why this isn't the case. He will then point at all the 3D games on this example list and complain about how they were not designed for people who have motion-sickness. How dare they not think of us, etc.

I will then try to show him all of the great games of these recent years that motion-sick people can play for hours on end without worry- but alas! He doesn't care for those! They don't look right, etc, etc.

I've tried to go about this in other ways. I'd ask him to list what game play/genre/mechanics that were the most important to him. This was years ago so I can't give you the specifics of what he wrote. It was very cut-paste of fantasy RPG with strategy and so on. I told him Pokémon fit this list perfectly (this was way before X&Y). He looked so offended at that suggestion... What? Why? This man knows I love Pokémon. He has never, ever mocked or thought me less for it. Heck, the only times I have ever talked Pokémon with him was because he'd bring it up. "What's in your handheld today?" "Pokémon Alpha Sapphire." "Breeding again?" "No, not today..."

I've tried asking him why. I mean, dear lord this man USED to play 2D games. The best explanation I have gotten out of him so far was that he had his fill of 2D games "back in the day". I'd try to get him to clarify, as all the games I show him were new. They don't all have the same mechanics or style as back then. No, no. The 2D is missing something.

I have told him this is the equivalent of saying, "I only watch PIXAR and refuse to watch anything made by Studio Ghibli because 2D is inferior." (he loves both studios. And dear lord, he's the one who got me into animation.)

He would not give me a response to that. I haven't brought it up since, because I'm tired of it. Dammit, I love him. In many ways we have so much in common. But we love these things so differently from each other it gets into these weird almost-arguments. But enough time goes from between these conversations that I get this hope that this time when he bring up this damn subject I'll get it right this time.

TLDR: Motion-sick man refuses to play games that won't make him motion-sick. He then gets mad at the industry for not making 3D games that won't make him motion sick.
